raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 13 was delivered twice (02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-18). The 327 duplicated txn_ids are exact copies that differ only in ingest_ts, so silver_transactions double-counts them, which also inflates every gold table. Deduplicating by txn_id in silver fixes silver and all downstream gold tables.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1;"}}
